"1. A writ, Order, or direction of appropriate nature to the respondent authorities to grant compensation amount to the petitioner as per the calculation of the deputy registrar (Annexure- P/2) as per the entitlement under the law, along with the solatium and interest rate of 12 in the interest of justice, equity and good conscious.

sentences.text: 2. The case of the petitioner is that his land was acquired for the purpose of construction of National Highway but the land acquisition officer/competent authority did not award proper compensation to the petitioner.
The petitioner seeks a direction to respondent/authorities to grant proper compensation.

3. From a perusal of the documents placed on record, it is seen that the petitioner has already availed alternatative remedy under Section 3G(5) of National Highways Act and has approached the Commissioner being arbitrator under the said provision for enhancement of said compensation.
4. As the petitioner has already avail alternative remedy, the reliefs as claimed in the present petition cannot be granted to the petitioner.

The petitioner is at liberty to prosecute his claim before the Arbitrator in terms of Section 3G(5) of National Highway Act and to avail further remedies as per Section 3G(6) of National Highways Act of the said Act.
5. The petitioner would be at liberty to raise all the grounds raised in the present petition in the said proceedings.
6. With the aforesaid direction, the petition stand disposed of.
